name: Sardinia

flag.description: A white field with a red cross, and in each quarter a black Moor's head in profile wearing a white headband tied at the back.
flag.symbolism: The Four Moors come from the arms of the Crown of Aragon, which ruled Sardinia from the 14th century; their origin is often linked to the Battle of Alcoraz in 1096.

hook: Sardinia is England's red cross with a Moor's head in every corner; Corsica keeps just one head and drops the cross.
trivia: For centuries the Moors were often shown blindfolded; the 1999 regional law fixed the bands on their foreheads.
The Four Moors also appear in the coat of arms of Aragon in Spain.
